A full-body upright standee is required for the standee layer only; the flat token, its master and the manifest mapping are unchanged.

references.note: The shipped flat norgos-guardian token: copy its matte painted miniature finish, colours, outfit and value structure. Ignore its top-down camera and its physical disc entirely - the standee has no disc.
Native norgos-guardian sprite: identity cue only. Keep the same species, gear, colours and markings, converted to a true upright standing composition; it is not a pose or proportion specification.
Norgos the Frozen in this batch is the sibling bear this one must stay clearly distinct from: it is rigid faceted blue ice, not a living warm-brown bear.

assets.render_evidence_note: No fixture run. Identity-render evidence is the pinned native sprite PNG and the shipped flat token PNG; the desc line in the pinned native NPC source is the appearance authority.

prompt_fields.subject: Norgos, the Guardian: a huge ancient brown bear REARING upright on his hind legs, a thick shaggy dark-brown pelt, a broad heavy chest and shoulders, rounded ears, a paler muzzle and small burning eyes, forelegs held down in front of the chest with heavy claws. Match the shipped flat token's warm brown fur and weight.
prompt_fields.contrast: Rearing tall and narrow: the bear stands on his hind legs with the forelimbs held close to the chest, so the body silhouette is clearly taller than wide. He differs from Norgos the Frozen by being a natural living bear with soft shaggy fur, rounded limbs and warm brown tones; the frozen one is rigid, faceted blue ice. No blood, frost, mist or particles.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, rearing upright front three-quarter view, both hind feet planted, forepaws hanging in front of the chest, the head at the top of the frame. Overall height about 1.6 to 1.8 times the width; nothing above the head.
prompt_fields.palette: warm dark-brown shaggy fur with lighter muzzle and chest, dark nose and claws, small amber eyes.

prompt_fields.subject: Norgos, the Frozen: a huge ancient bear frozen solid and carved in ice, REARING upright on his hind legs with one forepaw raised high and the head turned and tilted stiffly to one side; the whole body is sculpted from hard faceted blue-white ice with sharp angular planes, deep frost cracks, jagged ice shards along the back, frozen fur spikes and a rimed muzzle, eyes a dead pale glow. Match the shipped flat token's icy blue and white faceted ice, but rear upright.
prompt_fields.contrast: Rearing tall and narrow: the stiff raised forepaw is part of the body and points up beside the head, while the other forelimb hangs straight; the pose is rigid and asymmetric, unlike the living brown guardian whose forepaws both hang low. The body differs by sharp angular ice facets, frost cracks and ice shards, not only by colour. No snow, mist, particles or ground ice.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, rearing upright front three-quarter view, hind feet frozen to the pose, one forepaw raised high, the head tilted, the top of the raised paw or head at the top of the frame. Overall height about 1.6 to 1.8 times the width; nothing above the raised paw.
prompt_fields.palette: pale ice-blue and white faceted ice with deep blue crevices, frost-white highlights, dead pale blue eyes.
